x-card.description: Databases, containers, SQL queries and items. Changes wait for approval.

endpoint.title: Account endpoint
endpoint.description: The account's URI from its Keys page: https://<account>.documents.azure.com (.documents.azure.us in Azure Government, .documents.azure.cn in Azure operated by 21Vianet).

keyKind.title: Key
x-enumTitles: Primary or secondary key (read and write)
keyKind.description: Azure refuses every change made with a read-only key, so agents can't propose any. GateRook can't tell the keys apart without writing: say which one you paste.

accountKey.title: Account key
accountKey.description: A key of the account's Keys page (Read-only Keys, or Read-write Keys), the Base64 text of 88 characters.

tenantId.title: Directory (tenant) ID
tenantId.description: The tenant of the service principal, or one of its domains such as acme.onmicrosoft.com.

clientId.title: Application (client) ID
clientId.description: Give the principal Cosmos DB Built-in Data Reader to read, or Data Contributor for approved changes, on the databases or containers agents use: the data-plane roles are the boundary.

clientSecret.title: Client secret
clientSecret.description: The secret's Value, not its Secret ID.

databases.title: Databases
databases.description: The databases agents may use; * matches any characters, such as audit-*. Empty: every database the credentials may read.

containers.title: Containers
containers.description: The containers agents may use: a container ID such as orders (in every allowed database), or database/container such as app/customers; * matches any characters. Empty: every container of the allowed databases.

readConsistency.title: Read consistency
readConsistency.description: The consistency of queries and item reads. Cosmos DB refuses a level stronger than the account's default.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Policies set item limits and timeouts per environment.

crossPartitionQueries.title: Cross-partition queries
crossPartitionQueries.description: Off: every query names its partition key value, so none fans out over every partition and pays for each.

maxPages.title: Pages per query
maxPages.description: The pages of Cosmos DB's answer one call reads at most to fill its limit.

maxItemKb.title: Largest change
maxItemKb.description: The largest body a change sends. Cosmos DB takes up to 2 MB; the endpoint's request size applies too.
